scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path among trees and wildflowers, with a lake and village beyond and a shadowed road leading toward a distant hilltop settlement.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus walking in Galilee. The verse says he did not wish to walk in Judea because people were seeking to kill him; the landscape and shadowed road are an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man arranges leafy branches over a wooden booth while a woman and child hold more greenery; other villagers prepare shelters among sunlit stone buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 7:2 says the Jewish Feast of Booths was near. This imagined village preparation suggests its approach; the verse does not describe these people or their actions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens to two men in robes beside a stone house and olive trees, as one gestures toward a winding road through sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:3, where Jesus' brothers urge him to leave for Judea so that his disciples may see the works he is doing. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men converse in a shaded stone doorway; one gestures toward a sunlit square where people walk among stone buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation uses a shaded doorway and a public square to suggest the verse's contrast between acting in secret and showing oneself to the world. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus in a white robe and reddish mantle gestures gently while four men in earth-toned robes look on with reserved, questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter illustrates John 7:5, which says that even His brothers did not believe in Him. The courtyard, appearances, expressions, and poses are artistic choices. The English word glosses used for the scene are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and gestures as four men listen in a sunlit stone courtyard; several carry walking staffs and travel bags.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter illustrates Jesus saying that his own time has not yet come, while their time is always ready. The source excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking to a group in a sunlit village square while three onlookers frown. In the background, a bread seller turns away a man reaching toward the loaves.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 7:7, informed by the Berean Interlinear glosses: the disapproving onlookers and withheld bread evoke the world's hostility toward Jesus as he bears witness that its works are evil. The place and particular act are illustrative, not details stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man pauses beneath a tree and gestures to four traveling companions, who turn toward him on a rocky path leading uphill to a distant gathering.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined moment inspired by John 7:8: the speaker sends others to the feast while he remains, saying that his time has not yet been fulfilled. The setting and figures are an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree with four men nearby, overlooking a sunlit village, fields, distant hills, and water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus remaining in Galilee after speaking to them. The landscape, setting, and figures' poses are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks alone along a rocky uphill path, behind a group of men approaching a crowd and tents near a sunlit ancient city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:10: after his brothers went up to the feast, Jesus also went up, not openly but as if in secret. The setting, route, appearance and gathering are artistic choices. The excerpt's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard filled with feast-goers, a group gestures and asks an older man while people gather among fabric canopies, baskets, and food.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined festival scene reflects John 7:11, whose Berean Interlinear word glosses describe the Jews seeking him at the feast and asking where he is. The individual people, gestures, and surroundings are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town, people in robes converse in small groups: some smile as they speak, while others look doubtful. Jesus stands among people in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 7:12, where crowds murmur about Jesus: some say he is good, while others accuse him of deceiving the people. The setting, expressions, and Jesus' visible presence are artistic choices. The verse relationship follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four worried people sit together in a sunlit stone courtyard; one man whispers to a woman while their companions glance toward passersby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 7:13: the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses say that no one was speaking publicly about him because of fear of the Jews. The courtyard, people and whispered exchange are imagined, not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group seated on stone steps in a sunlit temple court, with feastgoers and colorful canopies behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:14, in which Jesus goes up to the temple and teaches in the middle of the feast. The people and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man gestures while six listeners look on in surprise in a sunlit stone courtyard; a closed scroll rests nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:15: listeners marvel and ask how the man knows writings without having studied, following the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses. The courtyard, scroll, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with an open hand and pointing upward while four listeners watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Jesus answering his listeners. His upward gesture suggests his words in John 7:16: his teaching is from the one who sent him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group in a sunlit stone courtyard while a listener offers a cup to a seated man and looks toward Jesus.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment relates to John 7:17: the listener's readiness to act and attention to Jesus' teaching evoke the verse's connection between desiring to do God's will and knowing whether the teaching comes from God. The courtyard and the sharing of water are imaginative details, not events described in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated teacher extends one hand toward the distant light as listeners gather, while another speaker at the side gestures toward his own chest.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined contrast illustrates John 7:18: one who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, while the one who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is true and without unrighteousness. The scene is an artistic interpretation, not an event stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits with one hand extended toward several listeners, some attentive and others wary. A rolled parchment rests on a stone table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus' words about Moses giving the law, the failure to keep it, and his question about why his listeners seek to kill him. The courtyard and scroll are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus faces a crowd whose members gesture toward him with puzzled and questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the crowd's response in John 7:20. The excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses present an accusation and a question about who seeks to kill the person addressed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, raising one finger as he speaks to a group of attentive, wondering listeners.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Jesus answering listeners who marvel at the one work he says he did; the particular work is not identified in this verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A teacher speaks to a family in a sunlit courtyard, while a woman cradles a swaddled baby beside an elder holding a closed scroll.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative gathering and swaddled infant suggest the ancestral practice of circumcision. John 7:22 says Moses gave circumcision, though it came from the fathers, and speaks of circumcising a man on the Sabbath. The verse does not describe this gathering or a baby. The reading follows the supplied Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a standing man as several listeners look on in a sunlit stone courtyard; a closed scroll rests on a table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Jesus' question in John 7:23 about anger at making a whole man well on the Sabbath, while circumcision is received on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses is not broken. The courtyard and visual details are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder listens to two men, one in fine clothes and one in worn clothes, as they gesture around a table holding a tied bundle and a small balance scale.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hearing illustrates the verse's call to judge righteously rather than according to appearance. The people and circumstances are artistic inventions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, several residents confer with worried expressions and gesture toward a robed man standing a little distance away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 7:25, where some Jerusalem residents ask whether this is the man whom others seek to kill. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a crowd in a sunlit stone courtyard while rulers watch quietly and two listeners exchange questioning glances.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 7:26: Jesus speaks publicly without a response, while listeners wonder whether the rulers have recognized Him as the Christ. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices, and the rulers' recognition remains a question.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in a red mantle stands among talking townspeople in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a man looks toward a winding road and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the speakers' claim that they know where this man is from and their expectation that no one will know where the Christ comes from. The courtyard, road and figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with one hand raised as listeners gather around him in a sunlit temple courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus crying out while teaching in the temple, as he speaks of the true One who sent him, whom his listeners do not know. The courtyard, gestures and listeners are artistic interpretation of John 7:28.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other raised toward the sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus saying that he knows the One from whom he comes and who sent him; the courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a sunlit stone courtyard while several men reach toward him without touching him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene reflects John 7:30: people sought to take him, yet no one laid a hand on him because his hour had not yet come. The excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks among a crowd in a sunlit stone courtyard. Many people look toward him while two men in the foreground speak together.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the crowd believing in Jesus and speaking about whether the coming Christ would do more signs than he has already done. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, robed religious leaders gesture to departing officers while people converse around Jesus in the crowd.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene follows John 7:32 as the Berean Interlinear word glosses present it: Pharisees hear the crowd murmuring about Jesus, and the chief priests and Pharisees send officers to seize Him. The setting, clothing, and arrangement of figures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to listeners seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, with a path winding toward a distant village and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to John 7:33, where Jesus tells his listeners he is with them for a little while and is going to the One who sent him. The courtyard and path are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several people search among stone village paths while a distant figure of Jesus stands on a sunlit hillside beyond a deep ravine.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for John 7:34: the searchers and the ravine suggest seeking without finding and being unable to come where Jesus is. The landscape is imagined, not a depicted historical location.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four Jewish men in robes converse in a sunlit stone courtyard; one gestures toward a winding road and a distant harbor with classical buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the questions in John 7:35. The distant road and harbor suggest the possibility the speakers discuss: that he might go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks. The verse presents this as a question.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group in robes exchanges puzzled looks and open-handed gestures in a sunlit stone courtyard while a distant figure walks away through an arch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects the question about the saying that people will seek the speaker without finding him and cannot come where he is. The setting, gestures, and departing figure are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open arms and speaks to a gathering in a sunlit stone courtyard. A man holding a cup moves toward Him as the others listen beneath leafy branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 7:37: on the great last day of the feast, Jesus stands and calls out, inviting anyone who thirsts to come to Him and drink. The courtyard, listeners and cup are imagined details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beside a believer under a tree as clear streams flow from the believer's clothed midsection into a green valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:38, picturing the rivers of living water that the verse says will flow from within the one who believes in Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on stone steps in a sunlit courtyard, speaking with an open hand to five attentive listeners. Vines frame the scene, with a village and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus speaking to people who believe in him as they await the Spirit. John 7:39 explains that they were to receive the Spirit and that the Spirit had not yet been given because Jesus had not yet been glorified; the setting and figures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a bearded teacher in cream and red robes addresses a crowd. In the foreground, one listener points toward him as others speak together.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:40: after hearing the words, some in the crowd say that he truly is the Prophet. The setting, expressions, and gestures are imagined; the supplied word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, people gather around a man in pale robes. One man gestures eagerly toward him, while another raises a hand and rests his other hand on his chin.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 7:41: some say the man is the Christ, while others question whether the Christ comes from Galilee. The courtyard, people, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four people discuss a blank scroll beneath an old olive tree as one gestures toward a distant stone village; a fresh shoot grows near the tree's roots and a solitary traveler walks the road.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's question about Scripture saying that the Christ comes from David's line and Bethlehem, where David was. The olive shoot and traveler are visual symbols, not events stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus stands calmly while clusters of people gesture and speak with differing expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 7:43's account of a division in the crowd because of Jesus; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands calmly in a sunlit stone courtyard while several men face him with tense expressions; some hold out their hands without touching him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 7:44: some wanted to seize Jesus, but no one laid hands on him. The setting and gestures are artistic choices. The verse relationship follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three armored officers face robed chief priests and Pharisees in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a leader gestures toward them with an open hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 7:45, where the officers come to the chief priests and Pharisees, who ask why they did not bring him. It follows the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses; the courtyard, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three officers in a sunlit stone courtyard answer a group of listeners, one gesturing with open hands, while a man speaks to an attentive gathering behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the officers answering that no one has spoken as this man speaks; the courtyard and arrangement of the figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed Pharisee gestures with open hands while other Pharisees and a seated group listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined setting for John 7:47, in which the Pharisees answer a group by asking whether they too have been deceived. The courtyard, figures, and gestures are artistic choices; the verse does not specify them. The wording is informed by the excerpt's Berean Interlinear token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several robed men gather in a sunlit stone courtyard as a seated elder gestures and the others listen thoughtfully.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined gathering gives visual form to the verse's question, expressed through the supplied Berean Interlinear token glosses, about whether any rulers or Pharisees believed in him. The setting and gestures are imaginative and do not settle the question.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient courtyard, a stern robed man holding a rolled scroll gestures toward a crowd of men and women who watch him with concerned or thoughtful expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene suggests the accusation in John 7:49 that the crowd does not know the law and is accursed. The setting, speaker, scroll, gestures and reactions are artistic interpretations, not details specified by the verse. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed Nicodemus gestures as he speaks among a group of men in a warmly lit stone room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering illustrates John 7:50: Nicodemus speaks to the group as one of them; the verse also recalls that he had previously come to Him. The room, clothing, and expressions are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A standing man speaks with open hands to four seated men in a sunlit stone chamber; an older listener gestures toward him while the others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hearing illustrates the verse's question about judging a man before hearing him and knowing what he does. The figures and setting are artistic inventions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone chamber, a robed man points to a blank scroll and gestures toward a listener while three other men look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for John 7:52, in which speakers ask a man whether he is also from Galilee and tell him to search concerning their claim that no prophet arises from Galilee. The setting, scroll and gestures are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men walk along separate stone paths toward homes in a sunlit village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The supplied Berean Interlinear glosses describe each person going home; the village, people, and paths are imagined.
